Aqaba's sea, up close

Aqaba sits at the top of the Red Sea, where clear water meets desert mountains. Aqaba Boat puts you in the middle of it: on a cruise, under the surface, in the air or on a jet ski. Come with family or friends, pick what fits your day, and enjoy the water.

Pick your day on the water

Six ways to enjoy the Gulf of Aqaba. Ask us which one suits your group.

Semi-submarine boat

Step below the waterline and watch the coral reef drift past the windows. You see the fish and colours of the Red Sea without getting wet, so it suits everyone in the group.

Cruise boat with a water slide

A big boat with open decks, shaded seating and a colourful slide. Sail across the Gulf, sit back with the view, or head up top and take the slide.

Evening cruise

When the sun goes down the boat lights up and the mountains turn gold. A calm way to end the day on the water with family or friends.

Jet ski

Open water, a life jacket and a Yamaha under you. Pick up speed on the Gulf of Aqaba and make your own wake.

Parasailing

Lift off behind the boat and float high above the Red Sea. Enjoy the whole coast of Aqaba from the air.

Scuba diving

Put on a mask and fins and dive with a group into the clear water. Aqaba is known for its reefs, and the sunset dives look special.

Relax on the sun deck

Shaded tables, long benches and a snack bar on deck. Take a break between activities with a cold drink and the mountains in view.
